author: Zephyr IV
title: CPS_v2: Publish Beacons to JSONL
abstract: Writes CPS_v2 beacons (S1-S3, R2') to JSONL with observed deltas for analysis ingest.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

jsonl_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/CPS_v2_Zephyr_IV.jsonl'
Path(jsonl_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

beacons = [
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v2:S1_shallow_train","last_sentinel_tick":405,"sentinel_delta":1200,"state":"Clean","path_complexity_est":1.0},
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v2:S2_shallow_train","last_sentinel_tick":407,"sentinel_delta":1150,"state":"Clean","path_complexity_est":1.0},
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v2:S3_shallow_train","last_sentinel_tick":409,"sentinel_delta":1100,"state":"Clean","path_complexity_est":1.0},
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v2:R2_recovery_sentinel","last_sentinel_tick":410,"sentinel_delta":1676,"state":"Borderline","path_complexity_est":1.0}
]

with open(jsonl_path, 'w') as f:
  for beacon in beacons:
    f.write(json.dumps(beacon) + '\n')

print(f"Wrote {len(beacons)} beacons to {jsonl_path}")
